invariants.rationale: The method always returns a HoodieWriteMetadata instance, constructed via the execute() method.
The getWriteStatuses() list in the HoodieWriteMetadata result should be non-null as standard semantics.
The size of a List is always >= 0; captures structure of write statuses.
preppedRecords is passed as a parameter and is expected to be non-null as part of the typical calling contract.
instantTime represents a point-in-time action and is expected to be a non-null and non-empty string for valid operations.
